metadata.title: ME2 — ALFRED: Voice Controlled Smart Device
metadata.claim_boundary: Wake-word and VCM inference run locally. Some action handlers use network-backed services.

encoder.temporal_mode: utterance-level full-context; not causal or streaming

dataset.preparation: Pinned benchmark release plus leakage-screened prior real-audio supplements. The winning supplemented_mixed condition includes the benchmark synthetic training partition but excludes the separate supplemental_synth extension.
leakage_controls: No speaker overlap across train, validation, test, and holdout
Sealed holdout excluded from training, HPO, calibration, and selection

training_cluster.execution: DGX cluster with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES restricted to one GPU
training_cluster.selection_protocol: Validation-only TPE HPO, followed by fixed-condition replication with seeds 231 and 947. Test reporting did not select the winner.
training_cluster.objective: Smoothed intent cross-entropy + 0.5 character-CTC slot loss + 0.5 binary in-scope BCE
training_cluster.optimiser: AdamW with learning-rate scheduling, gradient clipping, and augmentation

frozen_test_all_audio.note: Interpret with care: the frozen test contains 3,619 synthetic and 824 real clips. Real-speech metrics are reported separately in the experiment artifacts.

rejection_calibration.policy: Execute only if in-scope score and intent confidence both meet their thresholds.

raspberry_pi_5.status: Completed full physical benchmark on October 3, 2026: 202 Hugging Face holdout trials plus 16 no-wake trials
raspberry_pi_5.device: Raspberry Pi 5 Model B Rev 1.1, 8 GB, Debian GNU/Linux 13, aarch64

wake_word.implementation: Two custom OpenWakeWord transfer-learning classifiers with shared pretrained frontend and embedding models
wake_word.status: Original phrase-specific training manifests and held-out predictions were not retained; a dedicated real-audio evaluation is required.

github_repository.public_status: Not verified from local repository artifacts
github_repository.licence: MIT License for original project source code; datasets, model weights, voices, and third-party assets retain their applicable upstream terms

dataset_location.access_terms: Per-source terms are documented in docs/dataset_redistribution.md; 11,095 restricted-source supplement rows are metadata-only and require reacquisition from the original sources.

training_artifacts.status: Compact configurations, HPO records, metrics, predictions, plots, calibration records, and deployment metadata are retained in results/experiments; large reproducible checkpoints are excluded from Git.

model_weights.release_url: Included under alfred/assets/models/vcm/ with checksums in alfred/assets/models/manifest.json
model_weights.licence: Excluded from the repository MIT code licence; applicable dataset and third-party terms are documented in the repository
